text: Experts believe that Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) could change our world completely. Unlike today's AI, which handles specific tasks, AGI would understand and learn like a human. This could bring amazing benefits, such as curing diseases and solving climate problems. However, there are also serious risks. Some people worry that AGI might be difficult to control or could take jobs away from millions of workers. Predicting when AGI will arrive is hard. Some experts think it may come within 20 years, while others believe it is much further away. Either way, we need to prepare carefully for its impact.
